name: Create a custom Block Bindings source that uses post context
query: Book posts store the page count as integer post meta. Show it as a translated, formatted label like '1,024 pages' in a Paragraph inside the Query Loop on the books archive, and make it selectable in the editor's bindings UI.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run triage and search for existing meta and bindings sources
Step 2: Explain that core/post-meta cannot format the value, so a custom source is needed
Step 3: Register the source on init with register_block_bindings_source() using a namespaced lowercase name, a translated label, get_value_callback, and uses_context postId and postType
Step 4: In get_value_callback read postId from $block_instance->context, check the post type, check read access like core/post-meta does, and return null when nothing should render
Step 5: Format with _n() and number_format_i18n() and escape the plain-text result with esc_html()
Step 6: Register the editor side with registerBlockBindingsSource() using the same name, getValues reading the edited entity record, and getFieldsList returning fields with type string
Step 7: Leave out setValues (read-only computed value) and explain that the bound paragraph is therefore not editable
Step 8: Verify on the archive that each post in the Query Loop shows its own value, and that the source appears in the Attributes panel
success_criteria: Source name matches namespace/slug in lowercase and is registered on init
Callback returns null instead of an empty or unescaped value when unavailable
Uses translation functions with a translators comment and number_format_i18n()
JS registration uses the same source name and provides getValues and getFieldsList
Field type in getFieldsList is string so it is offered for Paragraph content
Mentions that Query Loop provides postId context per post
